Local SEO & Google Business Profile Optimization

Local SEO services, Google Business Profile optimization, local search optimization and Google Maps SEO determine whether your business appears first when someone in your city searches for what you offer. When a potential customer searches locally, your business needs to be in the map pack — and that requires expert Local SEO services covering Google Business Profile optimization, local search optimization and Google Maps SEO. Agentix delivers Local SEO services across home services, healthcare, legal, real estate, restaurants, gyms, auto services and financial advisors.

What's included

Everything you get with Local SEO & Google Business Profile Optimization.

01

Google Business Profile optimization

Complete GBP setup and ongoing optimization — primary and secondary categories, service areas, attributes, Q&A management, photo strategy and weekly posts that signal activity and relevance to Google's local algorithm.

02

Local keyword research

Geo-modified keyword research covering your city, neighborhoods, surrounding areas and service area terms — mapping high-intent local searches to your pages and GBP content.

03

Local citation building & NAP cleanup

Building consistent Name, Address and Phone listings across the 50+ directories Google uses as local trust signals — and auditing and correcting existing citations where data is inconsistent.

04

Local landing pages

Geo-targeted landing pages for every service area you serve — structured for both local search ranking and conversion, with unique content that avoids the duplicate-content penalty of templated location pages.

05

Review acquisition & management

A systematic process for generating authentic reviews on Google and industry-specific platforms — combined with professional response management that builds trust with future customers reading those reviews.

06

Local link building

Acquiring backlinks from local business associations, chambers of commerce, local news publications and industry directories — signals that reinforce your geographic relevance in Google's local algorithm.

Questions

Good to know.

Any business serving customers in a specific geographic area: home services (plumbers, electricians, HVAC, roofing), healthcare (dentists, chiropractors, urgent care), legal (personal injury, family law, criminal defense), restaurants and hospitality, real estate agents, gyms and fitness studios, auto services, financial advisors and many more. If your customers are local, local SEO matters.

Google Business Profile optimizations often produce map pack movement within 4–8 weeks. Sustained map pack rankings require ongoing optimization, review velocity and citation authority — typically showing strong results within 3–6 months of consistent work.

Yes — multi-location local SEO is a core service. We manage GBP profiles, citations and local landing pages across any number of locations, with consistent brand messaging and location-specific content.

NAP stands for Name, Address and Phone. Inconsistent NAP data across directories — a slightly different address format here, an old phone number there — sends conflicting signals to Google about your business's legitimacy and location. Consistent NAP across all listings strengthens your local ranking signals.
